intro: Financial services bore the brunt of a concentrated wave of cybercrime between April 13 and May 1, 2026, with 24 articles documenting 17 high-severity incidents. LockBit, Black Axe, and Chinese Transnational Organized Crime were among the threat actors observed targeting government, cybersecurity services, e-commerce, and gaming sectors. The impact was felt globally, with notable activity in the Caribbean, Germany, Latin America, and Southeast Asia.
